coverage: A selected teaching set of five representative places: three ports, one mining/processing district, and one city; not an Oceania-wide inventory of mines, factories, ports or service-sector employment.
coordinateMethod: Convert the cited primary source's degrees/minutes/seconds to decimal degrees; retain the published decimal city position. Plot as approximate representative geographic positions. The cited positions do not all state a datum and are not survey boundaries or navigation coordinates.

reuse.content: A small set of factual coordinates and original Japanese teaching explanations with primary-source links. Source publishers retain rights to their documents and images.
reuse.gaLicenseScope: CC BY 4.0 applies to the separately referenced Geoscience Australia mine dataset; it is not asserted as the license of every cited port or operator document.

limitations: Five selected representative positions are qualitative examples, not a countable regional inventory.
Missing representative marks do not mean absent industry.
Different source years are kept explicit; Lihir's 2023 information is not a 2026 operating-status claim.
No transport, shipping or mine-to-port lines are estimated.
The Suva symbol represents a city, while the Fiji industry description is national context.
